info.name: NomadTracks
info.summary: View your synced NomadTracks library on a map
info.description:
Browse the library that the NomadTracks mobile app (iOS / Android) syncs into the `NomadTracks/` folder of your Nextcloud files.
- Folder tree of your Tracks, POIs, Maps and Routes - Tracks (GPX) and POIs (GeoJSON) are drawn on an interactive MapLibre map - Track colors come from the `.nomadmeta.json` sidecars written by the app - Routes (`.nomadroute` packages) are drawn from the GPX embedded in the package - Custom map packages (`.nomadmap`) are listed but not rendered
This app is read-only: it never modifies the synced files. It requires the NomadTracks mobile app to have synced a library to this Nextcloud account. The base map is loaded from map.nomadtracks.app.
